documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Meeting Of Board Of Grameva Limited (Formerly Known As Bangalore Fort Farms Limited) ('Company') Held On Friday, July 10, 2026. Regulation 30 Read With Schedule III Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations')
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Grameva Limited reported strong financial growth for FY2025-26, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs. 8,268.09 Lakhs and Profit After Tax reaching Rs. 301.73 Lakhs. The company expanded its operations by entering the beverage solutions segment under the brand 'Brew Factor' and initiated new verticals including layer farming, feed mill operations, piggery, and fish trading. Management maintained a disciplined approach to financial management, working capital, and corporate governance.

guidance.claim: The company projects an improvement in productivity by around 10–15% over the next 2–3 years.
guidance.quote: It is anticipated that productivity will increase by around 10–15% over the next 2–3 years, supported by better capacity utilization and process improvements.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted increasing global demand for sustainable and traceable food supply chains.
demand_outlook.quote: With increasing global demand for sustainable and traceable food supply chains, India’s agro-processing industry is gaining strategic significance.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumers are increasingly demanding natural, chemical-free, and ethically sourced food.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumers are increasingly demanding natural, chemical-free, and ethically sourced food.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that domestic demand for Jute Goods remained robust during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for Jute Goods remained robust in domestic markets, contributing to stable operations and sustained business growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved several strategic initiatives to scale warehousing operations and explore adjacent opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved several strategic initiatives to scale our warehousing operations further and explore adjacent opportunities, including food processing and agri-infrastructure development.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit after tax increased to Rs. 0.49 crores, up from Rs. 0.34 crores in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit Before Tax has increased to Rs.0.55 crores from Rs.0.48 crores, and Net Profit After Tax stood at Rs.0.49 crores, up from Rs.0.34 crores in the previous financial year, a growth of over 44%.

capital_allocation.claim: No dividend has been recommended for the current financial year with a view to conserve profits.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances has not recommended any dividend for the current financial year with a view to conserve the profits generated.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.20 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors recommend a dividend of Rs. 0.20/- per equity shares of the company for the year under review to the shareholders whose name appears on the register of members as on the record date.

capital_allocation.claim: Secured loans decreased by Rs. 3,732 thousand during the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in commodity prices, supply chain challenges, and changing market dynamics continued to influence the overall business environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, fluctuations in commodity prices, supply chain challenges, and changing market dynamics continued to influence the overall business environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inadequate profits were primarily reported on account of increased cost of raw materials, higher finance costs, and overall slowdown in market demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company has reported inadequate profits during the year primarily on account of increased cost of raw materials, higher finance costs and overall slowdown in market demand, which adversely impacted margins.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects productivity to increase by 10-15% supported by better capacity utilization and process improvements.
management_commitments.quote: It is anticipated that productivity will increase by around 10–15% over the next 2–3 years, supported by better capacity utilization and process improvements.

management_commitments.claim: The company projects an improvement in profitability margins by 8-12% in the medium term.
management_commitments.quote: Consequently, the Company projects an improvement in profitability margins by 8–12% in the medium term, subject to normal market conditions.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
